objectives.statement: Recognize what common pragmatic markers add beyond the literal sentence meaning.
Choose markers such as jo, vel, nok, and gjerne to manage implication, uncertainty, and politeness.
Use evaluative sentence adverbs and extraposed attitude markers to show stance toward a whole situation.
Place discourse markers appropriately and avoid register mismatches in modern Bokmål.

notes: Late-B2 capstone for pragmatic control. Must teach softening, implication, stance, evaluative sentence adverbs, extraposed attitude markers, and register-sensitive discourse markers using modern Bokmål.
